notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Primary use: secure enterprise search for classified and unclassified archives. RAG pipeline: embed->index->rerank->policy filter.
- Scale expectation: initial index ~250M documents (mix of PDFs, PST exports, SharePoint), ~20M live vectors; growth forecast 2x/yr.
- Embedding req: local model (no external egress), prefer 1536-d embeddings or comparable, offline bulk embed job + incremental real-time ingest.
- Reranking: reranker on top of BM25 + vector recall; target end-to-end p95 latency <= 250ms for single-query path (must include rerank stage). Throughput target: baseline 300 qps sustained, burst to 1k qps for incidents.
- Cost sensitivity: execs want < $0.15/query effective cost (infrastructure + SW amortized) at baseline qps — why Redwood Optimize interest.
- Security: air-gapped environment, customer controls keys (HSM/FIPS), no telemetry leaving network. Need signed ATO-friendly artifacts (SOW, architecture diagram, data flow).
- Integration: SSO via SAML, SCIM for accounts, audit logging to on-prem ELK/SIEM, retention controls per record type.
- Failure & fallback: cannot use hosted fallback — require graceful degradation modes (local cached vectors, stale index mode).
- Quote from CISO: "We need deterministic behavior, zero egress, and a clear upgrade window for the on-prem runtime."
- Procurement notes: multi-stage procurement, requires SOC2 + supplier questionnaire + export-control checklist. PO approval path goes through prime; expected 6–9 months.
- Technical ask: run a small on-site performance demo in air-gapped lab (SE + infra) and provide kernel/quantization recommendations for 8x A100 equivalent.
